gate_options.title: Impulse gate
gate_options.invert_contact_description: Enable when the linked contact sensor reports "on" while the gate is closed
gate_options.contact_stale: The contact sensor is unavailable — the last known position is shown
gate_options.missing_required_role: Link the gate position sensor (a binary sensor with device class garage door, door or opening) before adding this device
gate_options.missing_required_link_warning: This gate has no position sensor linked, so it reports "closed" whatever the leaf does. Link a binary sensor in the "open_state" role.
gate_options.travel_time_description: Time the gate needs to travel end to end. 0 disables it: the position then changes only when the contact sensor reports. With a value set, the gate reports "opening" / "closing" right after the impulse — and for that whole time the Sber app blocks its control button in both directions, so a movement cannot be interrupted from the app until the timer runs out.
gate_options.auto_close_time_description: Enter the same delay your gate board uses to close the leaf after it was opened — the bridge cannot read that setting itself. 0 disables it. The countdown starts when the contact sensor reports the gate open, no matter who opened it: the app, a remote or a GSM call. When it runs out the gate reports "closing" until the sensor says otherwise, and the Sber app blocks its control button while that lasts. Set the leaf travel time as well: without it that "closing" is assumed to last 30 seconds, and a slower leaf is reported as open — with an active button — while it is still moving.

kettle_options.title: Kettle operation modes
kettle_options.unresolved: Not detected — the bridge falls back to turning the kettle on and off
kettle_options.no_modes: This kettle reports no operation modes, so the bridge switches it on and off directly.

type_overrides.title: Entity Type Overrides
type_overrides.description: Override the Sber device type for each exposed entity. 'Auto' uses automatic detection based on HA domain and device class.

device_sync.title: Device sync timing
device_sync.description: Sber reads every config publish as the COMPLETE device list, so one that omits a device makes the cloud drop it and re-register it later in the hub's room. The bridge waits for devices to report before publishing. Raise the settle delay if you have battery-powered Zigbee sensors that wake up slowly.

entity_not_found.description: Entity `{entity_id}` is in the exposed list but was not found in the entity registry. Remove it from the exposed list or check that the entity exists.

entities_without_state.description: {count} entities have no state yet: {entities}. They may not have been initialized or are unavailable.

broken_entity_links.description: {count} linked entities are not available: {links}. Check that the linked entities exist and are not disabled.

missing_required_links.title: Devices missing an obligatory linked sensor
missing_required_links.description: {count} device(s) cannot report their real state because an obligatory linked sensor is missing: {entities}. An impulse gate without a position sensor reports "closed" no matter where the leaf is. Open the Sber Bridge panel, pick the device and link the sensor for the listed role.

unacknowledged_entities.description: {count} devices were published to Sber cloud but not acknowledged. Sber may have silently rejected them due to invalid features or allowed_values. Affected entities: {entities}. Try removing and re-adding them, or check the Sber protocol documentation.
